messages:
alex_k: Quick async check — sprint status on hotpath batching + KV warmup. Need clear owners, blockers, and dates. Kernel latency spike still P1 for some nightly jobs. Continuous-batching canary planned next Tue but blocked by perf harness dependency. KV prefetch telemetry missing in prod dashboards. Who can own each?

benji: I can take kernel latency. PR 487 is the fix branch, still needs a perf run. Rough ETA 48h assuming code reviews.

carol_s: Re KV telemetry — I started a small exporter but never shipped the dashboard. I can finish it today and add the warmup curve metric. Will ping once dashboard link is up. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

davinder: Canary for batching — I'm on the rollout plan but need the infra perf VM pool. @infra-bot can you confirm pool availability? Also need SLO for 95th p99 to call it green.

infra-bot: perf-pool-check: available_instances=3, required_min=5 -> insufficient. ETA to scale: 12h (auto-scale pending quota). See https://infra.internal/pools/perform-42

erin_ml: I can fast-track quota with a short ticket. @davinder do you need GPUs in us-west1 or us-east1?

davinder: us-west1 preferred for latency parity. Thanks @erin_ml — if you can open the ticket I'll attach the canary job config.

benji: For the kernel fix, can someone review the micro-optimizations? Main change is in kernel/scheduler.cc around batch_window. Diff: ```diff
- if (window_ms > 10) window_ms = 10;
+ if (window_ms > 6) window_ms = 6; // tighten batching window for hotpath
```

carol_s: :eyes: I'll take the review now. Also we should add a perf test that exercises seq=2048 hotpath. Suggested command for QA: ```bash
perf-harness run --model=redwood-l2 --seq=2048 --iters=200 --p99
```

benji: Nice. After review I'll re-run CI w/ the harness.

alex_k: Dependency matrix quick note: kernel fix -> (blocks) continuous-batching canary. KV telemetry -> (unblocks) warmup sanity checks. perf-pool scale -> (unblocks) canary.

carol_s: Dashboard is up: https://dashboards.internal/kv-warmup — added warmup_latency_ms and kv_prefill_rate. I added alerts for warmup > 2s for >5% of requests.

davinder: Good progress. Next actions: @benji finalize PR + ping reviewers (target EOD), @carol_s verify warmup metric in canary, @erin_ml open quota ticket, infra to scale pool. I'll schedule a short async follow-up summary tomorrow.

benji: Pinged reviewers and added perf run artifacts to the PR. :thumbsup:

erin_ml: Ticket opened: INF-789, requested 3 extra GPUs in us-west1. Linking canary config in the ticket.

infra-bot: INF-789 acknowledged, auto-approve pending for team quota owners.

sre-oncall: FYI, will watch the canary rollout window. Please @mention me when you start the canary job so I can watch metrics and revert if necessary.

alex_k: Thanks all. I'll compile a short status for the sprint board later. If anything slips, call it out here. :rocket:
